goal_template: Create a valid executable Python smoke script named harness_smoke.py in the workspace that prints HARNESS_OK and exits with code 0, then complete the recipe. Objective: {{user_instructions}}

initial_state.test_cmd: python -c 'import pathlib,subprocess,sys; m=[p for p in pathlib.Path(".").rglob("harness_smoke.py") if "HARNESS_OK" in p.read_text(encoding="utf-8",errors="ignore")]; ok=bool(m) and all(subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(p)],timeout=10).returncode==0 for p in m); sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)'

scratchpad_checklist: Record the active objective and the next immediate action before completing
Create valid executable Python file harness_smoke.py printing HARNESS_OK via create_file
Call complete_recipe so the deterministic exit gate verifies the smoke file

post_llm_validation_hook.on_failure_instruction: No valid runnable **/harness_smoke.py containing HARNESS_OK was found. Use WorkspaceModule.create_file to write executable Python code (e.g. print('HARNESS_OK')) to harness_smoke.py, then complete the recipe again.
